entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. For questions about an existing order, press one. To place a new order, press two. For all other inquiries, please stay on the line.
Ugh, just get me a person.
Thank you for calling VeloFit Customer Support. My name is Sam. How can I help you today?
Hi, I need to return a VeloBand Pulse. It just doesn't fit right and the heart rate seems off.
I can certainly help you with that. Do you have your order number handy?
Yeah, hold on... It's VF90210-B. Got it?
Got it. Let me just pull that up... Okay, I see the order for the VeloBand Pulse. It looks like the tracking shows it was delivered to you 11 days ago, is that correct?
I guess. I don't know the exact day. So what? I want to return it.
I understand, sir. I'm just checking our policy, and it appears our return window is 10 days from the date of delivery. Unfortunately, this order is just outside of that timeframe.
You cannot be serious. One day? You're telling me I'm stuck with this thing because of one single day? I've been swamped at work! This is ridiculous.
I do apologize for the frustration. The policy is automated in our computer system, and it locks me out from creating a return label once the 10-day period has passed.
So that's it? I'm out $150? This is the last time I ever order from VeloFit. I want to speak to your supervisor.

I understand your position, and I really don't want this to be your last experience with us. Look... let me see if there's something I can do. This is definitely not standard procedure, and honestly, my **manager would kill me** if she knew I was even attempting this.
So you can do something?
Let me try to **override the system**. Since it is just one day past the deadline... okay... I'm going to process this as a **one-time exception** for you. Please hold for just a moment.

Okay, it looks like it went through. I've just emailed a prepaid return label to you. As long as the item is in its original condition, you'll receive a full refund once it gets back to our warehouse.
Wow. Okay. I got the email. Thank you, I really appreciate you doing that. I was starting to lose my temper.
It's no problem at all. I'm happy I could resolve this for you. Is there anything else I can assist with today?
No, that's everything. You really turned this around. Thanks again, Sam.
You're very welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a wonderful day.
